method: Separate whole-draft review after fit-count and routing-proof corrections against retained numerical, preservation and approval evidence; style review after drafting
score_reason: Concrete outcomes and measured differences make the report assessable; required section labels and repeated limits keep some mechanical style.
confidence_reason: Whole draft reviewed, but no human or calibrated independent style assessment.

examples.impact: Reader can distinguish tested behavior from deferred work
examples.quote: This arc does NOT cover fitted LMM/GLMM integration, weighted or multivariable logistic regression, interval calibration campaigns, Bayesian twins, JuliaCall, CRAN, arbitrary cross-language parity, remote CI or publication. It does not replace or land the retained old LMM checkout.

science_gate_reason: Claims match frozen one-predictor/unit-weight checks and resolved scientific review; no calibration or mixed-model claim.
facts_gate_reason: Counts, versions and source identities match saved outputs; missing Rose model/effort proof is explicitly unverified.
references_gate_reason: Repository evidence and actual skill/protocol paths support the claims; exact referenced manifests and patch are in this bundle.
